_comment: v23 Regression campaign — LightGBMRegressor predicts continuous future_return (%). No class labels, no imbalance. Dynamic thresholds adapt to regime + WR feedback. 48 combos × 2 windows = 96 runs (run bull window first).

_grid_rationale.long_threshold: Entry threshold in % predicted return. 0.5%=aggressive, 1.0%=baseline, 1.5%/2.0%=sniper. Dynamic regime multiplier still applies on top of this.
_grid_rationale.short_threshold: Same for shorts (stored as positive, negated in strategy). Symmetric grid — model should discover which direction benefits from which threshold.
_grid_rationale.label_period_candles: 24 candles=2h horizon. 48=4h. 72=6h (previous default). Shorter horizon = more labels but noisier signal. Test all three.
_grid_rationale.k_tp_k_sl: Not grid-searched in v23 — K_TP=2.0/K_SL=1.0 fixed for ATR stoploss. Stoploss is independent of the regression entry model.
_grid_rationale.why_regression: Classification with K_TP=2.0/K_SL=1.0 produced P(SL_first)=67% S-labels. LightGBM biased → 0 longs in bull market, 18% WR. Regression has no labels → no imbalance.

_root_causes_history.v18: Symmetric barriers k_tp=k_sl. Fee drag cancelled gross edge. PF 0.83-0.996.
_root_causes_history.v19_v20: ATR stoploss bug (guard < 0 instead of > 0). Fixed commit 21796ea.
_root_causes_history.v21: 4H regime gate blocked ALL longs in BEAR regime → 0 longs. Removed.
_root_causes_history.v22: Still classifier with K_TP=2.0/K_SL=1.0. Walk-forward WR 20.7%, Sharpe -9.79.
_root_causes_history.v23_baseline: Regression unblocked. First backtest (6-run sweep) showed WR ceiling at 35% for classifier. Regression eliminates root cause.
